lines.zh: 我没有脚，只有一圈浮动的火。
lines.en: I have no feet, only a ring of drifting flame.

lines.zh: 悬在岩浆上方，我从不落地。
lines.en: I hover above the lava and never touch ground.

lines.zh: 气流托着我，比走路省事。
lines.en: The heat lifts me; it costs less than walking.

lines.zh: 我所过之处，石头开始发红。
lines.en: Where I pass, the stone begins to glow red.

lines.zh: 别抬头找影子，我挡着光。
lines.en: Don't look for my shadow; I am the light.

lines.zh: 这一步跨过整条熔岩沟。
lines.en: This step carries me across an entire lava channel.

lines.zh: 火焰向前卷，我就跟着走。
lines.en: The flame rolls forward, and I go with it.

lines.zh: 我的轨迹留在空气里，像道疤。
lines.en: My path stays in the air like a scar.

lines.zh: 祭坛在下面，我绕着它转。
lines.en: The altar is below; I circle it slowly.

lines.zh: 走得再慢，热浪先到。
lines.en: However slow I drift, the heat arrives first.

lines.zh: 我的火不烧自己，只烧别处。
lines.en: My fire doesn't burn me, only everything else.

lines.zh: 下界之星在我胸口转了一圈。
lines.en: The nether star turns once inside my chest.

lines.zh: 我数着岩浆泡，一个又一个。
lines.en: I count the lava bubbles, one after another.

lines.zh: 祭坛上那圈黑曜石，缺了一角。
lines.en: That ring of obsidian on the altar is missing a corner.

lines.zh: 我抬手，火上就多一层蓝。
lines.en: I raise a hand and the flame gains a blue layer.

lines.zh: 挂在天花板上的钟乳石，被我烤化。
lines.en: The stalactites overhead soften under my heat.

lines.zh: 我在等下一次献祭，很有耐心。
lines.en: I wait for the next offering; I have great patience.

lines.zh: 火球在我掌心自己转起来。
lines.en: A fireball spins on its own in my palm.

lines.zh: 那些恼鬼绕着我飞，不敢靠近。
lines.en: The vexes circle me and keep their distance.

lines.zh: 我这张脸没有五官，只有火。
lines.en: My face has no features, only fire.

lines.zh: 空气在我周围扭曲成波纹。
lines.en: The air bends into ripples around me.

lines.zh: 我试着熄灭自己，做不到。
lines.en: I tried to put myself out; it doesn't work.

lines.zh: 熔岩照出我的样子，比想象的大。
lines.en: The lava shows my shape, larger than I imagined.

lines.zh: 我飘到王座上方，那里最热。
lines.en: I drift above the throne, where it's hottest.

lines.zh: 我肩上的火，今天偏蓝。
lines.en: The fire on my shoulder runs blue today.

lines.zh: 祭坛的灰又积了一层。
lines.en: Another layer of ash has settled on the altar.

lines.zh: 又一个带着下界之星的活人。
lines.en: Another living one carrying a nether star.

lines.zh: 你站得那么远，是怕热吗。
lines.en: You stand so far off. Afraid of the heat?

lines.zh: 我记住你的脸，火也记住了。
lines.en: I memorized your face; so did the fire.

lines.zh: 你脚下那块黑曜石，快化了。
lines.en: The obsidian under you is starting to soften.

lines.zh: 抬头，我在你上方三格。
lines.en: Look up; I'm three blocks above you.

lines.zh: 你的影子在抖，很有意思。
lines.en: Your shadow trembles; that interests me.

lines.zh: 我不用眼睛看，我用热看你。
lines.en: I don't watch with eyes; I read your heat.

lines.zh: 你身上有祭坛的味道，刚来过？
lines.en: You smell of the altar. Just arrived?

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我的火会趁那一刻。
lines.en: Don't blink; my fire moves in that instant.

lines.zh: 你这身护甲，撑不过我的火。
lines.en: That armor will not last against my flame.

lines.zh: 你身后的门已经烧成灰了。
lines.en: The door behind you has burned to ash.

lines.zh: 我等着你动手，等了很多年。
lines.en: I've waited years for someone to make a move.

lines.zh: 七百点血，你才削掉一层皮。
lines.en: Seven hundred points, and you've scratched the surface.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的火晃了晃。
lines.en: That blow made my flame waver.

lines.zh: 护甲二十，你打得很认真。
lines.en: Armor twenty; you're swinging with real effort.

lines.zh: 我不疼，我只是被打断了一下。
lines.en: It doesn't hurt; I was merely interrupted.

lines.zh: 你想靠磨，磨到什么时候。
lines.en: You plan to wear me down. Until when?

lines.zh: 火被压了一下，又窜起来。
lines.en: The flame was pressed down and flared back up.

lines.zh: 这点伤，祭坛一热就好。
lines.en: A little heat from the altar mends this wound.

lines.zh: 你打得动我，但打不完我。
lines.en: You can move me, but you can't finish me.

lines.zh: 我的火少了一层，就这些。
lines.en: One layer of flame gone; that's all.

lines.zh: 再来一次，我看你还有多少力气。
lines.en: Again. Let's see how much strength remains.

lines.zh: 再献一颗下界之星，我就醒透。
lines.en: Offer one more nether star and I wake fully.

lines.zh: 你身上的火光，我想收下。
lines.en: That flicker on you. I want to take it.

lines.zh: 有东西在烧，我就忍不住过去。
lines.en: If something burns, I can't help but drift over.

lines.zh: 岩浆的甜味，谁闻了都想靠近。
lines.en: Anyone who smells sweet lava wants to come near.

lines.zh: 你手里那把火，借我尝尝。
lines.en: That flame in your hand, let me taste it.

lines.zh: 祭坛的灰越厚，我越清醒。
lines.en: The thicker the altar ash, the clearer I think.

lines.zh: 叫一声我的名字，我就来。
lines.en: Speak my name once and I will come.

lines.zh: 你身上有灵魂的味道，勾人。
lines.en: You carry the scent of souls; it pulls at me.

lines.zh: 火把晃一下，我的头就转过去。
lines.en: A torch flickers and my head turns toward it.

lines.zh: 把火借我，我替你烧掉仇人。
lines.en: Lend me your fire and I'll burn your enemies.

lines.zh: 你撞进我的热浪里，皮肤会响。
lines.en: You walked into my heat wave; your skin will hiss.

lines.zh: 让开，我飘的路线不拐弯。
lines.en: Step aside; my drift does not turn corners.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我烧穿了你的披风。
lines.en: Don't press so close; your cloak is burning.

lines.zh: 我一侧身，你被热气推开了。
lines.en: I turn and the hot air shoves you back.

lines.zh: 这地方太窄，容不下我和你。
lines.en: This hall is too narrow for both of us.

lines.zh: 你挡在祭坛前，我过不去。
lines.en: You stand before the altar and block my way.

lines.zh: 我身上的温度，你会记住的。
lines.en: The temperature of me will stay with you.

lines.zh: 撞一下，你的护甲就软了一块。
lines.en: One bump and a plate of your armor softens.

lines.zh: 我不躲，撞上来的是你。
lines.en: I don't dodge; you're the one who collided.

lines.zh: 退三步，我给你留一条路。
lines.en: Back up three steps and I'll leave you a path.

lines.zh: 这片火海里，没有第二个我。
lines.en: In this sea of fire, there is no second me.

lines.zh: 若有一团火与我同高，我会认它。
lines.en: If a flame stood as tall as mine, I'd call it kin.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣是这口祭坛的火。
lines.en: My partner is the fire in this altar.

lines.zh: 两股热流靠近，会合成一团。
lines.en: Two currents of heat merge into one when they meet.

lines.zh: 我烧了几百年，也没烧出同类。
lines.en: Centuries of burning produced no equal of mine.

lines.zh: 你若是火，我就不会烧你。
lines.en: Were you flame, I would not burn you.

lines.zh: 火与火之间，不需要说话。
lines.en: Between two fires, no words are needed.

lines.zh: 我把最蓝的那层火留给它。
lines.en: I keep my bluest layer of flame for it.

lines.zh: 孤独的火烧得最久，也最冷。
lines.en: A lonely fire burns longest, and coldest.

lines.zh: 谁愿与我共燃，我就分它王座。
lines.en: Whoever burns with me may share my throne.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的铁，我拿来烧。
lines.en: Iron dropped on the floor goes into my fire.

lines.zh: 我用热浪把东西卷上来。
lines.en: My heat wave lifts things up to my hands.

lines.zh: 这把剑不错，可惜会化。
lines.en: A fine sword, a pity it will melt.

lines.zh: 我捡东西不用手，用火。
lines.en: I don't pick things up with hands, but with fire.

lines.zh: 你掉的盾，我收进火里。
lines.en: The shield you dropped goes into my flame.

lines.zh: 金子在岩浆里不会化，我要它。
lines.en: Gold survives lava; that is what I want.

lines.zh: 这块黑曜石，垫我的王座正好。
lines.en: This obsidian will do nicely under my throne.

lines.zh: 我拾起下界之星，它烫得刚好。
lines.en: I lift the nether star; it's hot in just the right way.

lines.zh: 东西一离地，就被我吸上来。
lines.en: The moment it leaves the ground, I draw it up.

lines.zh: 我留下的只有灰，捡走的都是燃料。
lines.en: I leave only ash; what I take becomes fuel.

lines.zh: 你踩上了祭坛的台阶。
lines.en: You stepped onto the altar's stair.

lines.zh: 那声献祭的响动，是你弄的。
lines.en: That offering sound. You made it.

lines.zh: 火焰替我指了方向，就在这。
lines.en: The flames point me somewhere: right here.

lines.zh: 活人带着下界之星，太显眼了。
lines.en: A living one carrying a nether star stands out.

lines.zh: 我等你抬头，等到了。
lines.en: I waited for you to look up; you did.

lines.zh: 这片火海只许有一个主人。
lines.en: This sea of fire allows only one master.

lines.zh: 你身上的水汽，让我很不舒服。
lines.en: The moisture on you makes me uncomfortable.

lines.zh: 我数过你的心跳，快了。
lines.en: I counted your heartbeats; they quickened.

lines.zh: 祭坛认了你，我可不认。
lines.en: The altar accepted you; I do not.

lines.zh: 你带来一把剑，我带来整片火。
lines.en: You brought a sword; I brought an entire fire.

lines.zh: 别回头，出口已经被烧塌。
lines.en: Don't look back; the exit already collapsed in flame.

lines.zh: 我闻到你手上的火药味。
lines.en: I smell gunpowder on your hands.

lines.zh: 站上那块黑曜石，你就算入场。
lines.en: Stand on that obsidian and you're in the fight.

lines.zh: 这场火，从我醒时就开始了。
lines.en: This fire started the moment I woke.

lines.zh: 你的脚步踩暖了这块石头。
lines.en: Your steps have warmed this stone.

lines.zh: 从这面火墙后，我看见你。
lines.en: I see you from behind this wall of flame.

lines.zh: 你把门推开，热气先扑你。
lines.en: You pushed the door open; the heat reached you first.

lines.zh: 谁在祭坛边喘气，是你。
lines.en: Someone is breathing hard by the altar. It is you.

lines.zh: 你跑到哪，热浪就跟到哪。
lines.en: Wherever you run, the heat wave follows.

lines.zh: 我的火球比你跑得快。
lines.en: My fireballs travel faster than your legs.

lines.zh: 你躲到柱子后，柱子先烧起来。
lines.en: Hide behind a pillar; the pillar burns first.

lines.zh: 我升高三格，你就看不见我。
lines.en: I rise three blocks and you lose sight of me.

lines.zh: 那些恼鬼会替我把你赶出来。
lines.en: The vexes will drive you out for me.

lines.zh: 你喘气的声音，在火里很清楚。
lines.en: Your breathing is very clear inside the fire.

lines.zh: 我不用追，我只要把路烧断。
lines.en: I needn't chase; I just burn your path shut.

lines.zh: 潜影贝的弹子会追上你。
lines.en: The shulker bullets will catch up with you.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，祭坛就热一分。
lines.en: Every step you retreat, the altar grows hotter.

lines.zh: 慢慢地烧，我不着急。
lines.en: I burn slowly; there is no hurry.

lines.zh: 你头顶那片天花板，是我留的。
lines.en: That ceiling above you is a gift I left.

lines.zh: 我听见你的靴子在熔岩边打滑。
lines.en: I hear your boots slipping near the lava.

lines.zh: 你往哪边跑，哪边的石头就红。
lines.en: Whichever way you run, the stone turns red.

lines.zh: 这场追逐，我的火不会累。
lines.en: In this chase, my fire never tires.

lines.zh: 我让火沿着墙根爬向你。
lines.en: I let the fire crawl along the wall toward you.

lines.zh: 你数着退路，我数你的心跳。
lines.en: You count your exits; I count your heartbeats.

lines.zh: 再绕两圈，火就围满了。
lines.en: Two more circles and the fire will close.

lines.zh: 你先跑，我慢慢追。
lines.en: Run first. I will follow slowly.

lines.zh: 天花板上的火，正往下落。
lines.en: The fire on the ceiling is starting to fall.

lines.zh: 你躲在柱后，柱子太细。
lines.en: You hide behind a pillar. It is too thin.

lines.zh: 这一掌带着火，能削掉半条命。
lines.en: This burning palm can take half a life.

lines.zh: 我挥手，火墙就压过去。
lines.en: I wave and a wall of flame bears down.

lines.zh: 你挡得住剑，挡不住热。
lines.en: You can block a blade, not the heat.

lines.zh: 二十点的力道，你算算。
lines.en: Twenty points of force; do the arithmetic.

lines.zh: 我的拳头是压缩的火。
lines.en: My fist is fire pressed into a shape.

lines.zh: 你被打飞，撞在祭坛上。
lines.en: The blow sends you into the altar stones.

lines.zh: 这一击，我连击退都省了。
lines.en: For this blow I don't even need knockback.

lines.zh: 火从你脚底往上烧。
lines.en: The flame climbs from the soles of your feet.

lines.zh: 我近身一次，你就少一层甲。
lines.en: One close pass costs you a layer of armor.

lines.zh: 我的火不熄，你的盾会。
lines.en: My fire doesn't go out; your shield does.

lines.zh: 别用木盾，那只是柴。
lines.en: Don't raise a wooden shield; that's just kindling.

lines.zh: 我打你一下，空气都焦了。
lines.en: One hit from me scorches the very air.

lines.zh: 你以为退开就安全了？
lines.en: You think distance makes you safe?

lines.zh: 我的攻击带着整座祭坛的火。
lines.en: My strike carries the fire of the whole altar.

lines.zh: 祭坛吞下下界之星，我醒了。
lines.en: The altar swallowed a nether star, and I woke.

lines.zh: 黑曜石圈里，火从我脚下升起。
lines.en: Inside the obsidian ring, fire rises beneath me.

lines.zh: 天花板裂开，我从中飘下来。
lines.en: The ceiling splits and I drift down through it.

lines.zh: 七百年了，又有人来献祭。
lines.en: Seven hundred years, and someone offers again.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，整片熔岩都亮了。
lines.en: I open my eyes and all the lava brightens.

lines.zh: 火焰先来，我的身体随后成形。
lines.en: The flame arrives first; my body forms after.

lines.zh: 我悬在祭坛上方，等第一句话。
lines.en: I hang above the altar, waiting for a first word.

lines.zh: 那些恼鬼从墙缝里钻出来迎我。
lines.en: The vexes squeeze from the wall cracks to greet me.

lines.zh: 我的重量没有落下，只有热落下。
lines.en: My weight doesn't fall; only the heat does.

lines.zh: 下界之星在我胸口，还烫着。
lines.en: The nether star in my chest is still hot.

lines.zh: 你要活过最后一击，才算见过我。
lines.en: Survive the last blow and you've truly met me.

lines.zh: 祭坛的灰被我一口气吹散。
lines.en: One breath of mine scatters the altar's ash.

lines.zh: 别跪，跪下的活人我不留。
lines.en: Don't kneel; I don't spare the kneeling.

lines.zh: 火已经封了出口，我们开始吧。
lines.en: Fire has sealed the exits; let us begin.

lines.zh: 祭坛裂了，我从缝里升起。
lines.en: The altar cracked, and I rose from the seam.

lines.zh: 火光先聚成一团，再成人形。
lines.en: The flames gathered into a mass, then into a shape.

lines.zh: 我落地时，四周的石头全红了。
lines.en: When I landed, every stone around turned red.

lines.zh: 这次献祭，灰比上次多。
lines.en: This offering left more ash than the last.

lines.zh: 我睁眼，先看见你的影子。
lines.en: I opened my eyes and saw your shadow first.

lines.zh: 我从岩浆里站起来，很慢。
lines.en: I rise out of the lava, slowly.

lines.zh: 用火烧我，你倒是很有想法。
lines.en: Attacking me with fire. That's imaginative.

lines.zh: 我从高处坠下，火却没灭。
lines.en: I dropped from a height, and the fire survived.

lines.zh: 水浇上来，我咳出一团白汽。
lines.en: Water hits me and I cough out a cloud of steam.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推远，火还在烧。
lines.en: The blast pushed me back; the fire still burns.

lines.zh: 箭穿过火，落地时已经焦了。
lines.en: The arrow passed through fire and landed charred.

lines.zh: 魔法压住我的火，只压了一瞬。
lines.en: Magic pressed my flame down for a single instant.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，只吃烧着的东西。
lines.en: I don't eat food; I eat what burns.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，火更旺了。
lines.en: Lightning struck me, and the fire grew brighter.

lines.zh: 虚空没有空气，我的火也缩了。
lines.en: The void has no air, and even my fire shrinks.
